subject: Marketplace pricing: composable bundle offer & channel uplift evidence
messages:
From: Julian Park <julian.park@cloudbridge.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: ResellerOne <sales@resellerone.co>
Date: 2027-09-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial pricing details and channel uplift evidence request

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — team is excited about the composable bundle approach (reserved node hours + metered inference) that Redwood showed. Procurement asked me to get a couple things inline before we progress to legal:

1) Can you confirm whether marketplace private offers allow bundling a reserved capacity SKU (node-hour commitment) with a metered SKU under a single PO?
2) We need documented channel uplift (reseller) math: what % is available to ResellerOne on: (a) reserved capacity, (b) metered gen tokens, and (c) add-on support? We need a single-page exhibit that our reseller program can sign off on.
3) Your commercial team mentioned a possible list-price floor exception for strategic partners — any precedent or thresholds we should expect?
4) Can you attach a strawman SOW and a pricing workbook we can circulate with procurement?

Please send to me and cc ResellerOne; our timeline is tight (legal wants a mutual action plan by next Thursday).

Cheers,
Julian

--
Julian Park
Head of Procurement, CloudBridge
procure@cloudbridge.com
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: ResellerOne <sales@resellerone.co>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial pricing details and channel uplift evidence request

Julian — thanks for the clear asks. Looping Camila (pricing ops) and Ben (channel) so we can give you a single deliverable. Quick answers up front:

- Bundling: yes, we can put a reserved capacity SKU and a metered SKU on the same private offer. The private offer will map to two line items in the PO but can be represented in one SOW/exhibit.
- Channel uplift: standard starting point is 12% on reserved, 8% on metered tokens, 6% on professional support add-ons. Those are flexible for strategic pilots.
- List-price floor exceptions: possible but require a minimal annual commitment or a co-sell/marketing contribution.

I'll attach a pricing workbook (v2) with a model that shows blended effective price, and a draft SOW for your review. Camila — can you add the reseller exhibit (single-page) and flag what minimum commit would justify a floor exception? Ben — can you confirm whether ResellerOne needs evidence of past sales/marketing commitment or if a signed partner MOU is sufficient?

Attaching: pricing_workbook_v2.xlsx, CB_SOW_v3.pdf

Next steps: we'll aim to get a marked-up SOW + reseller exhibit back by EOD so you can route to legal.

Best,
Naomi
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, ResellerOne <sales@resellerone.co>
Date: 2027-09-18T11:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial pricing details and channel uplift evidence request

Julian / team — taking the modeling POV here. I've uploaded a quick reseller exhibit (covered below in the workbook and a CSV extract). Highlights:

- Reseller split assumptions (proposal):
  • Reserved SKU (annual node-hour commit): 12% reseller rebate off list before any committed discount.
  • Metered generation (per 1M tokens): 8% reseller rebate off list.
  • Support (annual plan): 6% reseller rebate.

- Effective blended % depends on composition. In the attached pricing_workbook_v2.xlsx I included three scenarios: Reserved-heavy (70/30), Balanced (50/50), Metered-heavy (30/70). The bundle_econ.csv contains the extract you'll want for procurement (row-per-sku, bundle price, reseller-share, redwood-net).

- Floor exceptions: to go below our published floor we'd need either: (A) a 12-month minimum ARR commitment >= $600k, or (B) an upfront marketing development fund (MDF) at 3% of ARR for joint GTM. If you can indicate which bucket you prefer we can draft the exception clause.

I've attached bundle_econ.csv for procurement consumption.

Cheers,
Camila
Sr. Pricing Analyst, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Julian Park <julian.park@cloudbridge.com>
Cc: ResellerOne <sales@resellerone.co>
Date: 2027-09-18T13:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial pricing details and channel uplift evidence request

Quick note from channel: ResellerOne is already in our partner registry (tier: Gold) which means we can proceed with the standard uplift, no additional vetting. For an exception to the list-price floor I recommend we propose: 10% uplift on reserved (vs. 12% standard) in exchange for a 9-month marketing pilot (co-branded webinar + case study) and a signed MOU committing to target 3 named accounts in Q4.

If CloudBridge agrees, I'll draft the partner exhibit and a short acceptance form ResellerOne can sign. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to finalize wording.

-Ben
Channel Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Julian Park <julian.park@cloudbridge.com>, ResellerOne <sales@resellerone.co>
Cc: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial pricing details and channel uplift evidence request

Julian — putting everything in one place so procurement/legal have what they need. Attached: CB_SOW_v3.pdf (draft SOW with two line items: RB-Reserved-Ann and RB-Metered-Gen), pricing_workbook_v2.xlsx (three scenario tabs + reseller exhibit tab), bundle_econ.csv (extract for procurement).

Action items for CloudBridge:
1) Confirm preferred path for a floor exception: (A) 12-month $600k ARR commit or (B) 3% MDF. If you pick (B) please indicate whether MDF is refundable on performance.
2) Confirm ResellerOne acceptance of the marketing pilot (Ben suggested 9 months + 3 named accounts).
3) If approved, we will produce a one-page partner exhibit and a signature page to include in the private offer.

DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.example.com/CLB-2027-0918/sow (we'll send after you confirm the exception path).

Thanks — we can slot a 20-min sync tomorrow if helpful.

Best,
Naomi
Director, Marketplace Partnerships
Redwood Inference

---
Attachments: CB_SOW_v3.pdf (SOW stub, 3 pages); pricing_workbook_v2.xlsx (model, reseller tab); bundle_econ.csv (procurement extract)
